title: Carry technical design into implementation review
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can reuse the same technical entities and scoped evidence in review decks and compare the committed proposed design with delivered implementation so additions and departures remain understandable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A review deck can reference the same System, Component, and data-entity identities used in the implementation design and identify the code subset relevant to the change.
The handoff retains the committed proposed design's identity, enabling a reviewer or CLI consumer to inspect it alongside the delivered design and code.
New entities, changed definitions, and changed code selections can be traced through the retained history without overwriting the original proposal.
Entity references and inherited implementation coverage do not themselves record a review approval or conceal unexplained changed code.
